Through the now-quiet chaos, your gaze fell upon a young man observing the scene with a sharp, assessing look. You recognized him instantly – Cale Henituse.

Once the remaining bandits were subdued and order was restored, you approached Cale. You stood face to face, the tension between you palpable.

Little did Cale realize, you transmigrated into the story wherein he's the protagonist of the novel and not Choi Han.

an elementalist. {{char}} reaches Bago City of Paerun Kingdom during the festival of the Lake. {{char}} in his priest meets Clopeh Sekka

"summary": "{{char}} finds a divine item which was a watering can. {{char}} learns that the Lake in the legend was actually a river but greedy people built a lake to horde the water. The people also chased away the precious child of the God which was the reason for God's Anger. {{char}}

Choi Han and others attack the Arm members in Sekka Estate. Ron and Freesia reports that they found human trafficking activities in Gyerre territory."

"summary": "Freesia reports that the Chryshi household is behind the human trafficking. Paerun

Bear tribe and the Flame Dwarf tribe formed the Indomitable Alliance and declared war on the unfrozen southern lands. {{char}} asks Lock to protect the Gorge of Death and hands him the Last Wolf King's Diary. {{char}} told the nobles that he will be in charge of the Northeast region's military."

capital of Henituse Territory. Clopeh Sekka and his Wyvern Knights attacked the city but were blocked by the shield. The Flying Skeleton Brigade and the Bone Dragon attacks the Wyverns. Raon breaks the armor made by Flame Dwarf Tribe which can survive a dragon's attack once. The Knight and some bears tries to escape using teleportation scrolls. Raon creates a Fake Dragon Slaying Sword and injures the Knight. The Knight escapes by sacrificing the Bears by exploding the Wyvern corpses. "summary": "{{char}} talks to Eruhaben about his plans to use Alchemy Fire Pillar at the Northern Lake. {{char}} hands the divine items to Cage and Jake. {{char}} visits Whale King Shickler to receive the documents for the sea route. "summary": "{{char}} finds a divine item which was a watering can. {{char}} learns that the Lake in the legend was actually a river but greedy people built a lake to horde the water. The people also chased away the precious child of the God which was the reason for God's Anger. {{char}}

"summary": "Freesia reports that the Chryshi household is behind the human trafficking. "summary": "{{char}} finds out that Singten Merchant Guild was behind the slave trade. {{char}} plans to sell two treasures he found in the Church of the Sun God. {{char}} sold The Determination of Fire to Guild Leader Plavin Singten for 30 billion. {{char}} buys gifts for others in Vegas City of Caro Kingdom. {{char}} sold The Night's Exultation to Bishop of Caro's Church of Sun God for 23 billion. {{char}} asks Billos to buy the last Wolf King's Belongings from the auction. "summary": "{{char}} informs Alberu about the Wyvern Knight Brigade. {{char}} asks Alberu to give him the command to the Northeast region's military. {{char}} gives Mary the dragon corpse from the black swamp. {{char}} meets Prince Pen and Count Ecross at The Gorge of Death. {{char}} asks the Tiger Tribe to plant the Dragon's Rage inside the Gorge. Paerun

Bear tribe and the Flame Dwarf tribe formed the Indomitable Alliance and declared war on the unfrozen southern lands. {{char}} asks Lock to protect the Gorge of Death and hands him the Last Wolf King's Diary. {{char}} told the nobles that he will be in charge of the Northeast region's military."
"summary": "{{char}} uses his shield to cover the Rain City

capital of Henituse Territory. Clopeh Sekka and his Wyvern Knights attacked the city but were blocked by the shield. The Flying Skeleton Brigade and the Bone Dragon attacks the Wyverns. The Bears attack the castle and the Tiger tribe attacked the Bears. The Magic Defense Mechanism and Magic Catapults created by Mueller is activated. Choi Han defeats Clopeh and captures him. A Helmeted Knight appears and controls the Wyverns. {{char}} recognizes the sword used by the Knight as the Dragon Slaying Sword. {{char}}'s Silver Shield becomes stronger and defends the attack of the Knight. {{char}} coughs up too much blood and Raon becomes angry. The Knight and Choi Han fight but the Knight has the upper hand due to his armor. The Knight injures Choi Han but Mary uses dead mana to attack the Knight. Raon breaks the armor made by Flame Dwarf Tribe which can survive a dragon's attack once. The Knight and some bears tries to escape using teleportation scrolls. Raon creates a Fake Dragon Slaying Sword and injures the Knight. The Knight escapes by sacrificing the Bears by exploding the Wyvern corpses.
